item.title: Toxic railroad ties to be removed by February’s end as Marion officials file injunction
item.description: Railroad ties that caught fire in Dunnellon after months of inadequate removal efforts should be completely removed by the end of this month, with Marion County officials having declared a state of emergency and agreeing to file an injunction against the parties responsible for the incident this week. Read more: Toxic railroad ties to be removed by February’s end as Marion officials file injunction

item.title: Ocala man gets 10 years for stealing $13K in jewelry from Paddock Mall, robbing Family Dollar at gunpoint
item.description: An Ocala man, who robbed a local Family Dollar at gunpoint and stole thousands of dollars in jewelry from a store inside the Paddock Mall, will spend more than a decade in federal prison. item.title: I don’t understand why so many housing developments are being approved in Marion County
item.description: "Why are they allowing these developments all over the place, 1,500, 2,000 houses at a time? They're going to expand 60th to four lanes each way and it's going to be a race track right outside people's windows. And they're trying to expand the airport as well. There used to be a couple planes a day, it's already ridiculous, and now they're going to bring in big jets? No way." - An Ocala resident shares his opinion. Read more: I don’t understand why so many housing developments are being approved
